title: Playnite Mapping (v1, adapter-only)
description: Schema for library/mappings/playnite/<uuid>.json. Playnite UUIDs are never treated as canonical identity and never embedded in game.json; they exist only as adapter-only mapping records that translate Playnite's local database identifiers to the canonical game id. The Playnite database itself is never written by this system.

playnite_uuid.description: Playnite's local GUID for the game. Must equal the <uuid> filename stem.

game_ref.description: Canonical game id this UUID currently resolves to.

adapter_only.description: Always true. Documents that this record is a translation aid, not an identity source; canonical identity is Steam AppID, storefront ID, or retro system+slug+release.
